notes: §1985:IV.4.3.8.2.3 SR4: "Each table element reference must be subscripted except when such reference appears" in a USE FOR DEBUGGING statement, "As the subject of a SEARCH statement", in a REDEFINES clause, or "In the KEY IS phrase of an OCCURS clause." Every ordinary reference is read by ReadSubscripts, whose ScreenSubscriptArity refuses a table element written with no subscript (COBOL2270); the screen has no edition arm and the exceptions are the entry points that do not reach it: the SEARCH subject resolves through ResolveSearchTable and ResolveTableOperand, the USE FOR DEBUGGING operand through AddDebugDataTarget (which resolves the declaration and refuses a subscript there, COBOL6334, as §1985:XV.3.2.3 SR10 requires), REDEFINES through ResolveRedefinesPass.Run and KEY IS through OccursKeyResolvePass.Run (§1985:VI.5.8.3 SR4). The exceptions §2023:8.4.2.3.3 SR5 adds are closed at 85: the table SORT and its KEY are refused by VisitSortStatement (COBOL0870), a screen section is refused at every edition (COBOL1560), and a SUM addend that is a working-storage table element is refused unsubscripted. Probed at --std 85: an unsubscripted table element, elementary or group, qualified or not, a condition-name on one and a reference-modified one are refused as a sending and a receiving operand of MOVE, in MOVE CORRESPONDING, DISPLAY, ACCEPT, ADD, COMPUTE, IF (relation, class, condition-name), EVALUATE, INITIALIZE, INSPECT, STRING, UNSTRING, SET, PERFORM TIMES and VARYING, GO TO DEPENDING, CALL USING, WRITE FROM, READ INTO, a function argument, a subscript, SEARCH VARYING and WHEN, and the report section's SOURCE and SUM; SEARCH ELEM, SEARCH ELEM OF TBL, SEARCH ALL with ASCENDING KEY IS K, a REDEFINES of a table element and USE FOR DEBUGGING ON ALL REFERENCES OF ELEM compile and run with the element unsubscripted. The witness is MOVE ELEM TO X, refused with COBOL2270.

next.reason: §2023:8.4.2.3.3 SR5 keeps the SEARCH subject, REDEFINES and OCCURS KEY IS exceptions. It drops 1985's 'In a USE FOR DEBUGGING statement' (the debug module is gone) and adds SORT KEY and table SORT, screen FROM/TO/USING, and 'As a data-name addend in the SUM clause of a report description entry'. The set of permitted unsubscripted references differs. No refusal became an exception condition.
